gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-lexend: Lexend draws open-jawed curves in tubelike lines. Capture Smallz brings raw, tactical swagger in big-bodied lowercase, and the sans below keeps the text smooth and steady beside that loud heading.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca follows Capture Smallz with a plain, unshaded line whose terminals stop short of curling. Lexend Deca makes paragraph after paragraph go down easily, since its small-looking capitals stay modest beside big lowercase.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-liter: Raw on top, ruled below, with Liter doing the ruling. Capture Smallz hits hard with big-bodied lowercase, but the pair's standout quality is Liter's monoline construction, with no stroke contrast at all.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-mada: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz grabs the eye with big-bodied lowercase. Mada, a sans-serif with a towering midzone and curves that refuse to close, does the steadier text work.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans lets every curve breathe, its high mean line running across each word. But Capture Smallz is the one for punch, raw and tactical in big-bodied lowercase, where Martel Sans is better at quiet sentences.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-matangi: Capture Smallz stands out for its big-bodied, raw, tactical lowercase. Matangi follows with twine-like strokes and a hefty lowercase, so paragraphs of text feel rounded, sturdy and thoroughly modern.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-maven-pro: Capture Smallz hits with big-bodied lowercase and a raw, tactical attitude. Maven Pro steps in beside it with a laser-etched, constant-width line and a high-waisted lowercase, giving the loud heading a tidy partner.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-michroma: Contemporary in spirit, Michroma gives each letter a wide berth, with tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascender tips beneath Capture Smallz. Standout quality: Michroma's daylight-filled curves against that raw, big-bodied heading.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-miriam-libr: Approachable and sturdy, Miriam Libre draws wire-weight strokes beneath Capture Smallz's raw, big-bodied lowercase. Miriam Libre should carry paragraphs comfortably, its s opening generously and its stems and crossbars sharing one thickness.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-mochiy-pop-: Loud meets laser-cut: Capture Smallz is raw and tactical, with big-bodied lowercase. And Mochiy Pop One, a plain sans cut to a single stroke width with an oversized lowercase eye, gives it steady footing.
